name: Studio
tagline: A dense, near-black workbench for agent chats: quiet chrome, compact rows, a boxed prompt.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file for color, settings for type and density, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view for the sidebar's hover card and rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
